LanguageData.HE_Inti_Unku.label: unku tunic
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Unku.description: A knee-length tunic of fine alpaca wool, woven with squares of tocapu patterns and a stepped band at the waist. Warm on cold mornings.
LanguageData.HE_Inti_QuiltedTunic.label: quilted war tunic
LanguageData.HE_Inti_QuiltedTunic.description: Layers of cotton quilted tight and soaked in brine until stiff, then faced with a chequered war pattern. Light, but it stops slings and arrows.
LanguageData.HE_Inti_PlumedHelm.label: plumed war helmet
LanguageData.HE_Inti_PlumedHelm.description: A round helmet of woven cane faced with bronze, crowned with a fan of macaw feathers. Officers are seen and followed across the field.
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Mascaypacha.label: mascaypacha
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Mascaypacha.description: A braided band wound around the head with a fringe of red wool over the brow and three feathers above. It is the crown of the Sapa Inca.
LanguageData.HE_Inti_FeatherCape.label: feather cape
LanguageData.HE_Inti_FeatherCape.description: Thousands of red, yellow, green and blue feathers knotted onto cotton in rows. It takes the weavers of a whole village a season to make one.
LanguageData.HE_Inti_FieldCoat.label: Inti field coat
LanguageData.HE_Inti_FieldCoat.description: An ochre field coat with a band of tocapu across the chest and a gold sun badge at the throat.
